version.changelog: Simplify the login instructions to the code flow (maton login prints a link; finish with maton login --code <CODE>), drop the API Key subsection, and pin the Maton CLI install to 0.4.0.

llm.summary: This is a clearly documented Google Drive integration that uses managed OAuth and discloses its write, credential, and automation risks.

dimensions.detail: The skill needs network access and access to the user's authorized Google Drive, which is sensitive but proportionate for a Drive integration and bounded by provider OAuth scopes and Maton connections.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation is via pinned Maton CLI package instructions; the inspected package is Markdown/reference material with no bundled executable scripts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions repeatedly default to read/list operations, require explicit user approval for connection creation and all writes, and mark Gmail and other event-source references as platform catalog material outside the Google Drive skill's own capability.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: OAuth tokens persist in the OS credential store, and optional hosted functions, triggers, and destinations can persist until removed; the artifact discloses this and requires user approval, least privilege, DENY_ALL network defaults, and cleanup guidance.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill purpose is Google Drive file and folder operations, and the documented capabilities fit that purpose: list, search, download/export, upload, create, update, delete, share, and optional user-approved automation.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable authorizing Maton to access the selected Google Drive account. Prefer OAuth login over API keys, confirm the exact account and file IDs before writes, and treat sharing, deletion, hosted functions, triggers, and destinations as separate high-impact actions that need explicit approval and later cleanup when no longer needed.
llm.findings: [SDI-1] expected: The Gmail trigger reference is present, but both the main skill and the Gmail file explicitly identify it as shared Maton platform event-source reference text that does not widen Google Drive capability and should only be used when the user has connected that source and asks for it by name.
